decisionRule: Per position, with the best DvP variant's relative change in RMSE against B00 in development (2017-2023), validation (2024) and the holdout (2025): PROMISING if the frozen candidate is a DvP variant and it cuts RMSE by at least the practical minimum (1%) in all three periods; NOT_USEFUL if the best DvP variant misses the minimum in all three; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise; BLOCKED if an integrity check fails (frozen hashes, coverage, projection dependency). Globally: PROMISING with the positions that are; NOT_USEFUL if every position is; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. A paired holdout interval that excludes 0 is reported as stronger evidence, not required.

holdout.exposure: v0 (2026-11-23) and Phase A (reliability lab) described 2016-2025, 2025 included, for repeatability only. No 2025 forecast was made or inspected, and no parameter was estimated on 2025: candidates came from development folds 2017-2023 and were frozen before the 2024 validation. The Phase B variant designs (a last-season prior, non-touchdown points) drew on Phase A's descriptive findings, which included 2025.

prospective.plan: Forecast these weeks with this frozen method, each from the actuals available before its cutoff, once the season is complete and the targets are rebuilt; evaluate with the same protocol. Confirmatory, independent of every earlier season.

protocol.metric: RMSE per position on common rows, relative to B00
